title: Source-transcription evidence for unclassified autumn/moon seams
purpose: Record what external transcriptions actually support for B=たま, D=むす, and D=こた without converting plausible segmentations into source-image-confirmed facts.

evidence_policy.promotion_rule: Transcription evidence may refine a hold status, but source-image confirmation and semantic review remain distinct.

findings.title: 同（露）

surfaced_text.yamauchi_mirror: やとるつゆ 玉は軒端の 葉にしけし 庭のはきのは またゆつるとや
surfaced_text.independent_secondary: 宿る露 玉は軒端の葉に繁し 庭の萩の葉 またゆず(づ)るとや

supported: Forward B reading たま corresponds to explicit 玉 in both surfaced transcriptions.
The following は belongs after 玉 and therefore lies on the C side of the A/B/C lattice split.
Reverse reading また is visible as a separate surface sequence in the latter half.
not_supported: A globally transferable morphology for every また occurrence.
A single lexical category/meaning for reverse また across the corpus.

proposed_signature.reverse_parse: また（surface token; function not globally fixed）

findings.queue_effect: Can move from raw-unclassified to source-specific conditional review; do not merge with blocked B2=また signature from other poems.

findings.title: 嫁娘見月

surfaced_text.yamauchi_mirror: なかよさの 来つるみそらは むすめよめ すむはらそ見る つきのさ夜かな

supported: The source title explicitly contains 嫁娘見月 and the central reading is surfaced as むすめよめ.
D=むす lies inside the surfaced lexical sequence むすめ.
Reverse D=すむ appears at the beginning of the following mirrored phrase すむはらそ見る.
not_supported: The kanji or exact lexical analysis of reverse すむ.
A claim that むす↔すむ is transferable outside the shoju-add-109 corridor.

proposed_signature.forward_parse: むす…（inside surfaced むすめ; title supports 娘 context）
proposed_signature.reverse_parse: すむ…（independent phrase onset; lexical analysis unresolved）
proposed_signature.signature: word-internal noun onset -> source-specific phrase onset

findings.queue_effect: Three affected hybrids may be advanced to a source-specific semantic-review queue only if the central corridor remains inherited from shoju-add-109; no global seam promotion.

findings.title: 田毎月

surfaced_text.yamauchi_mirror: なかきよの きつるみちもと こたしろし 田こともちみる 月のよきかな

supported: Reverse D=たこ begins with explicit 田 followed by the next surfaced kana sequence こ..., so the mirrored D crosses a lexical boundary.
The source title is 田毎月 and the fourth phrase begins with explicit 田 in the surfaced transcription.
not_supported: A reliable forward lexical parse for こた inside こたしろし.
Whether the following こ belongs to 毎/ごと under devoicing or another segmentation without source-image checking.
findings.queue_effect: Remains held. The reverse boundary is clearer, but forward morphology is still insufficient for crossover.

next_actions: Keep D=こた as the highest-value unresolved morphology problem because it blocks three candidates.
For B=たま and D=むす, create a separate source-specific candidate-review lane rather than changing v0.36 global seam rules.
Seek source image or another independent transcription before upgrading reverse また/すむ lexical functions.
